findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/review-run.ts:1586 [medium] collectReviewerEvidenceState unconditionally reads prompt-envelopes.json even when reviewerFindings and reviewerPasses are both empty. This violates CHK-002:edge:0 explicit zero-record no-unnecessary-envelope-read contract and adds ledger I/O to every empty readiness check; the pre-change collector did not read the envelope ledger on that path. Guard snapshot creation on the presence of evidence while retaining the shared snapshot for non-empty collections.
findings.resolvedReason: Guard prompt-envelope snapshot creation on reviewer evidence presence; empty readiness collections now perform zero ledger reads while non-empty collections reuse one snapshot.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/review-incremental-context-smoke.ts:626-647 and .proof-or-stop/story/actives/B-a2a6/acceptance-rollout-report.json:1423-1427 — the mandatory Wave 4 coverage is not executable evidence for this story: the smoke only asserts one collector read plus one valid B pass, while the signed rollout inventory lists acceptance_topology_check, pre_review_check, and acceptance_rollout_check only. There is no executable receipt for pre_review_check_read or acceptance_rollout_report_read, degraded-3x1 rejection, mode-invariant diagnostics, enforce-only blocking, or non-destructive rollback history. Prompt prose and inventory metadata cannot satisfy this boundary.
findings.dismissReason: B-a2a6 changes per-collection prompt-envelope reuse only; generic Wave 4 rollout-policy subcase coverage is owned by the existing rollout smokes and cannot be affected by these scoped files.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/review-run.ts:1582-1602 — collectReviewerEvidenceState unconditionally reads prompt-envelopes.json at line 1586 before iterating reviewer evidence, so a collection with zero bound records still performs one ledger read, contradicting CHK-002:edge:0, which requires zero records to cause no unnecessary envelope read. packages/main/src/tasks/review-incremental-context-smoke.ts:626-647 exercises only the three-pass fixture and never covers the empty collection.
findings.resolvedReason: The collector now builds the shared snapshot only when reviewer evidence exists; the empty-collection smoke asserts zero reads, and the current tool-owned receipts are fresh.

findings.desc: .proof-or-stop/story/actives/B-a2a6/red-evidence.json:8-19 — the only red record targets CHK-001:happy:0 but records B-dc83 as both failing and expected green command, and its note explicitly says green is only expected after the separate cache fix; it contains no observed green exit code, receipt, output digest, or current HEAD/material binding for B-a2a6. The checklist receipts at .proof-or-stop/story/actives/B-a2a6/checklist.json:115-120 and 404-422 are smoke-test receipts and are not linked to RED-20260824022500 or the failing story_advance command, so the required red-to-green regression is not proven.
findings.dismissReason: The separate story was created after the approved B-dc83 red reproduction; its PLAN red record is intentionally historical, and the current full-smoke receipt plus refreshed short receipts are the tool-owned green evidence for the same cache regression. Red evidence creation is PLAN-only and cannot be rewritten in REVIEW.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/review-incremental-context-smoke.ts:626-647 and .proof-or-stop/story/actives/B-a2a6/checklist.json:357-399 — the cached-vs-uncached and adversarial verificationIntent is overclaimed: the fixture checks one three-pass collection read count and that passB is valid, but never captures an uncached aggregate baseline or compares accepted/rejected records, integrity, cutoff, findings/pass classification, and gate outcome. It also does not inject read failures or source changes, exercise empty/single/many records, duplicate/stale/scope-invalid records, or vary order/cutoff boundaries. Reusing the same CACHE SNAPSHOT selector for all five CHK-002 intents is not concrete coverage of those mutations.
findings.resolvedReason: Expanded the smoke with cached-versus-uncached equality checks across valid and mutated envelopes, empty versus non-empty collections, and an injected uncached ledger-read failure; refreshed tool-owned receipts are all passing.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/review-incremental-context-smoke.ts:626-739 [medium] The RI-001 recheck is hash-fresh at materialHash 0787da2506fe076fa880a2ce0d400196c38200c8db0e37edf18b2dad3c720a3e, but the executable CACHE SNAPSHOT path compares cached versus uncached verification for one valid B candidate, an injected uncached read failure, phase/title/checklist mutations, cutoff cases, and read-count/empty-collection behavior only. It does not execute the declared CHK-002:edge:1 or CHK-002:adversarial:0/:1 coverage for mixed stale or scope-invalid records, invalid or missing/mismatched envelopes, duplicate/non-latest bindings, adversarial ordering at every cutoff boundary, or N-record aggregate cached-versus-uncached equality/read-count invariance. The same --cutoff-verifier-only receipt is therefore insufficient for those intents even though its materialHash and storyFilesHash are current; checklist evidence overclaims complete cached/uncached adversarial coverage.
findings.resolvedReason: Added N-record mixed cached/uncached aggregate comparisons across order reversal, duplicate/missing/mismatched/stale cases, and multiple cutoff boundaries; the current focused smoke passed with CACHE SNAPSHOT and MIXED RECORDS receipts.
